spec2def(ucdfs.dll ucdfs.spec)

# ucdfs.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ucdfs-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(ucdfs_shims OBJECT ucdfs.c)
target_link_libraries(ucdfs_shims PRIVATE cdfslib libntdll)
add_cargo_module(ucdfs ucdfs-cargo ucdfs.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ucdfs_shims psdk)
